package tools

// Copied into a scratch checkout of upstream fa7aed75 by regenerate.sh.
// It drives that checkout's real GrepTool.Execute with a deterministic fake rg
// and records the rg argv and the tool output. The only normalisation is
// replacing the scratch fixture root with {{ROOT}}.

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func TestGenerateGrepGolden(t *testing.T) {
	fix := os.Getenv("GOLDEN_FIXTURES")
	if fix == "" {
		t.Skip("GOLDEN_FIXTURES not set")
	}
	root, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(t.TempDir())
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	tmpl, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(fix, "rg_stream.jsonl.tmpl"))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	bin := t.TempDir()
	data := filepath.Join(bin, "data.jsonl")
	argsFile := filepath.Join(bin, "args")
	os.WriteFile(data, []byte(strings.ReplaceAll(string(tmpl), "{{ROOT}}", root)), 0o600)
	// Builtins only: PATH contains just the fake rg directory.
	script := "#!/bin/sh\nprintf '%s\\n' \"$@\" > '" + argsFile + "'\nwhile IFS= read -r line || [ -n \"$line\" ]; do printf '%s\\n' \"$line\"; done < '" + data + "'\n"
	os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(bin, "rg"), []byte(script), 0o755)
	t.Setenv("PATH", bin)

	var cases []struct {
		Name string          `json:"name"`
		Args json.RawMessage `json:"args"`
	}
	raw, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(fix, "cases.json"))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &cases); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	norm := func(s string) string { return strings.ReplaceAll(s, root, "{{ROOT}}") }
	for _, c := range cases {
		in := strings.ReplaceAll(string(c.Args), "{{ROOT}}", root)
		out, err := NewGrepTool(nil, DefaultOutputLimits()).Execute(context.Background(), json.RawMessage(in))
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		a, err := os.ReadFile(argsFile)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		os.Remove(argsFile)
		os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(fix, c.Name+".args"), []byte(norm(string(a))), 0o644)
		os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(fix, c.Name+".out"), []byte(norm(out.Content)), 0o644)
	}
}
